MANAGEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Management Services Agreement is between Clearwater Dental Management LLC ("Manager") and Clearwater Family Dentistry, P.C. ("Practice").

1. Services. Manager will provide billing, staffing, purchasing and office space to the Practice.

2. Clinical Matters. The Practice and its dentists make all clinical decisions.

3. Fee. The Practice will pay Manager a monthly management fee of $45,000.

4. Term. This Agreement has a term of ten years.
